posts.content_md: Hi, it's me again a noobie in holography, sorry for disturbing, now, everythings i have it except the most troublesome thing, holographic film, seems like my country is unfamiliar about the holographic film, currently i stay in Malaysia, actually What kind of shop can i find the holographic film instead of buying tru on9, AND, can i use the usual "hologram effect" paper or sticker as a film ???? plz give me a best solution for this in urgent thxs !!!!!!!!!

posts.author: JohnFP
posts.content_md:
Well, I wasn't quite sure how to answer this and I was hoping someone from you country could give you specifics.

I do not know what is allowed to be purchased world wide from the internet at you country.

But I will say you can not use the usual "hologram effect" paper or sticker as a film. You need to use a very high resolution film, specifically made for holography. 

A suggestion may be, if you have a photogaphy store in your area, you can ask them to order it for you. There are many on line sources for holographic film and plates.
